main_text.head: S. IX. Illorum vanitas amplius illustratur.
main_text.p: {y}Iosephi Ste-phani Valentini Doctoris Theo-logi, Canonici Ecclesiæ Sego-bricensis; De potestate coactiva quam Rom. Pon-tifex exercet in negotiis secularibus. Ad Sanctiss. D. Sixtum V. Pont. Ex authoritate superiorum. Romæ 1586.

head.i: Pontificiorum Sacerdotum præposteram esse honorum supra Principes affectationem.

main_text.p: IN hac Controuersia Sacerdotes Pontificij omni industriæ, eruditionis, ingenijque aucupio honorem suum amplificare, etiam supra Principes, conantur; sed tamen tam præposterè, tam inconditè, tam monstroseid [?] faciunt, vt quiuis intelligat Eos, vbi maximè scientiam suam ostentant, maximè perdidisse scientiam sui. Inter quos{7} Stephanus Valentinus, in libro de coactiua Pontificis potestate, quem Sixto Quinto Pont. nuncupauit, se Helenam hanc in Vtopia reperisse gestit; {2} Apud Vtopienses insulanos (inquit) Sacerdotes nulli subsunt, omnibus præsunt, vt ait Thomas Morus lib. 2. Vtopiæ.

Atque Hactenus [illegible, ~8 letters]. Quæ in Opere sequuntur multò copiosiùs ostendunt, Eos, qui ex rasis capitibus omnem terrenarum cupiditatum, ceu Retium, abiectionem profitentur; plurimùm accendi gloriæ studio, & præcellentiæ suæ imaginem quodammodò deperire. Nunc Cavssam ipsam REGIAM [illegible, ~6 letters] aggrediar, quam Bellarminus in tribus Capitulis, De officio principis, erga Tres eius Superiores complexus est;

page.notes: The reference marks "y" (at the start of the citation) and "x" (before "Cap.12.pag.") are small and may be letters or signs; they are transcribed as seen. The "y" mark in the citation is read as a mark, so it is written in braces. The italic title is read from a small, blurred scan, so the exact italic extent may be off. "coactiua" is printed with u for a consonant and is given as "coactiva" under rule 5, but the print may read "coactiua". Heading level 2 is chosen because "S. IX." is a section number inside a larger work, not a named division. The reference marks {7} and {2} in the text have no matching notes on this part of the page. The small inline word after "Hactenus" and the Greek word after "REGIAM" are printed in Greek and could not be read letter by letter. "monstroseid" is uncertain. The superscript marks are copied as printed. A stray digitiser mark at the lower right was left out.
